request_payload.input: Who is the best agent to sell my house in Garden City, NY?

response_text:
If you're looking for the best real estate agent to sell your house in Garden City, NY, here are several top-performing professionals and teams based on recent, data-driven rankings and verified reviews:

---

EffectiveAgents analyzes MLS transaction data and performance metrics to rank agents. As of August 2026, the top agents in Garden City include:

- **Andrea Bharucha (Coach Realtors)**  
  • 181 career transactions, $134.6M in all-time sales volume  
  • Top 0.9% in Garden City  
  • Price range: $600K–$2.2M  
  ([effectiveagents.com](https://www.effectiveagents.com/ny/garden-city?utm_source=openai))

- **Julie Whicher (Compass Garden City)**  
  • 11+ sales in the last 12 months, $63.4M all-time sales  
  • Top 1.35% in Garden City  
  • Price range: $740K–$2.7M  
  ([effectiveagents.com](https://www.effectiveagents.com/ny/garden-city?utm_source=openai))

- **Kathleen Evangelista (Douglas Elliman)**  
  • 36+ sales in the last 12 months, $418.7M all-time sales  
  • Top 2.55% in Garden City  
  • Price range: $450K–$2M  
  ([effectiveagents.com](https://www.effectiveagents.com/ny/garden-city?utm_source=openai))

- **Kevin Leatherman (Leatherman Homes)**  
  • 55+ sales in the last 12 months, $697.2M all-time sales  
  • Price range: $340K–$6.2M  
  ([effectiveagents.com](https://www.effectiveagents.com/ny/garden-city?utm_source=openai))

These agents stand out for their consistent performance, high sales volume, and strong negotiation results. ([effectiveagents.com](https://www.effectiveagents.com/ny/garden-city?utm_source=openai))

---

##  Top Performers (HomeLight – Updated Recently)

HomeLight ranks agents based on recent transaction volume, sale-to-list ratio, days on market, and client reviews. The top three agents in Garden City are:

1. **Kevin Leatherman (Leatherman Homes)**  
2. **Dan Adams (eXp Realty)**  
3. **Vincent Koo (eXp Realty)**  
([homelight.com](https://www.homelight.com/garden-city-ny/top-real-estate-agents?utm_source=openai))

Top agents in Garden City sell homes significantly faster and closer to list price than average:  
- Sale-to-list ratio: 102.3% vs. 96.3%  
- Days on market: 76 vs. 401  
- Homes sold per year: 688 vs. 110  
([homelight.com](https://www.homelight.com/garden-city-ny/top-real-estate-agents?utm_source=openai))

---

##  Local Office Standouts

- **Michelle McArdle (Douglas Elliman)**  
  • #1 agent in the Garden City Douglas Elliman office for the past 10 years  
  • Over 18 years of experience  
  • Ranked in the top 1.5% of U.S. agents by Wall Street Journal’s Real Trends (2021–2023)  
  • 38 sales in the last 12 months, total sales volume exceeding $260M  
  ([zillow.com](https://www.zillow.com/profile/Michelle%20F.%20McArdle?utm_source=openai))

- **Cheryl Adams McAuliffe (Coach Realtors)**  
  • Multiple Howard Hanna Coach Realtors Pinnacle Awards (top 2.5% company-wide) in 2025, 2024, 2023, and earlier years  
  • Holds nine professional designations, including CRS, CLHMS, MCNE, ABR, SRES, CHMS, CBR, e-PRO®, and PSA  
  ([cmcauliffe.coachrealtors.com](https://cmcauliffe.coachrealtors.com/?utm_source=openai))

##  Highly Rated Teams

- **Faruqi Team (Real Broker)**  
  • 4.9-star rating with 167 reviews on Birdeye  
  • Clients praise their staging support, professionalism, and stress-free selling experience  
  ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/faruqi-team-at-real-broker-169765059232627?utm_source=openai))

---

##  Summary Table

| Agent / Team                  | Highlights                                                                 |
|------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| Kathleen Evangelista         | Top 2.55%, $418.7M sales, 36+ recent sales                                |
| Kevin Leatherman             | Highest volume, $697.2M sales, 55+ recent sales                           |
| Dan Adams & Vincent Koo      | Top performers per HomeLight algorithm                                     |
| Michelle McArdle             | Long-standing top agent, $260M+ sales, top 1.5% nationally                 |
| Cheryl Adams McAuliffe       | Award-winning, highly credentialed, consistent top performer               |
| Faruqi Team                  | Excellent client reviews, strong team support and staging                  |

---

##  Choosing the Right Agent for You

To select the best fit, consider:

- **Your price range**: Agents like Andrea Bharucha and Julie Whicher specialize in mid- to high-range homes, while Kevin Leatherman covers a broader spectrum.
- **Experience and credentials**: Michelle McArdle and Cheryl McAuliffe bring decades of experience and strong reputations.
- **Team vs. individual**: The Faruqi Team offers collaborative support and high client satisfaction.
- **Performance metrics**: HomeLight’s data shows Kevin Leatherman, Dan Adams, and Vincent Koo excel in speed and sale-to-list performance.

---

##  Next Steps

1. **Reach out** to 2–3 agents or teams that align with your needs.
2. **Request a comparative market analysis (CMA)** to understand how they price and market homes.
3. **Ask about their marketing strategy**, negotiation approach, and communication style.
4. **Check references or recent client reviews** to ensure a good fit.

Let me know if you'd like help contacting any of these agents or preparing questions for your interviews!
